total_supply.meaning: ERC-20 totalSupply value used as scaling factor in mint/redeem formulas

sum_balances.meaning: sum of balanceOf[] across all accounts

ghost_shares.meaning: constructor-set shares never minted to any account (zero corresponding balances)

value_skimmed_occurred.meaning: value is stealthily skimmed into the void, permanently disadvantaging honest users

formulas_use_total_supply.meaning: Both the share-minting and redemption formulas use totalSupply as a scaling factor.

assumptions: The constructor-set 1,000,000 shares are the only supply source and no other minting occurs before the checked accounting.
The conservation invariant is evaluated at the share-accounting level (totalSupply vs sum of balances), not at an asset-value level.
No concrete deposit or withdrawal transaction is described; the relation is checked symbolically over the accounting state.

unresolved.description: The report does not give the deposit/redemption formulas or their operands, so the quantitative over-mint/under-pay relation and the 'value skimmed' magnitude cannot be expressed numerically; only the supply-vs-balances conservation relation is formalized.
'Value is stealthily skimmed into the void' is unquantified and treated as a potential downstream effect; it is bound only as a Boolean occurrence symbol.

limitations: The selected impact value_skimmed is a potential downstream consequence; the formalized relation is the supply-vs-balances conservation whose violation underlies it, not a numeric value-loss amount.
The over-mint (deposit_over_mints) and under-pay (withdrawal_under_pays) impacts are separate claims handled in other passes and are not formalized here.
No attacker action or concrete transaction is modeled; the plan is a symbolic accounting-state relation.
